props.title: Build pages visually
props.subtitle: Drag and drop your own Vue components onto a canvas. The output is plain JSON — render it anywhere.

props.heading: How it works
props.body: Register your Vue components with a typed config. Users drag them onto the canvas — the output is plain JSON you render anywhere.

props.title: Headless
props.description: Your components, your styles. Gissen is a runtime, not a UI framework.

props.title: Type-safe
props.description: Prop types are inferred from your field definitions. Mismatches are caught at compile time.

props.title: Agent-native
props.description: An MCP server lets AI agents build pages programmatically — same JSON, same config.
